Advertisement View all journals Saved research Search Account Log in Content Explore content About the journal Publish with us Subscribe Sign up for alerts RSS feed nature nature water news & views article News & Views Published: 15 October 2026 Drought Atmospheric drying translates unevenly into river drought Xiaomang Liu ORCID: orcid.org/0000-0002-9076-4164 1 & Kaiwen Wang 1 Nature Water ( 2026 ) Cite this article Save article View saved research Climate warming is increasing atmospheric evaporative demand and strengthening some measures of drought, but the consequences for water availability depend on how this climate signal propagates through terrestrial water systems. An analysis of nearly 19,000 catchments shows that river-flow drought responds heterogeneously, underscoring the need to match drought assessments to the impacts of interest.
